@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Able to understand difficult concepts, d______ns are one of the smartest animals in the world.
= dolphins
~詞義 dolphin（n.）海豚
~原文 Able to understand difficult concepts, dolphins are one of the smartest animals in the world.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: "Don't be so g______y! Leave some of that cake for your sister!" the mother said angrily to her son.
= greedy
~詞義 greedy（adj.）貪心的
~原文 "Don't be so greedy! Leave some of that cake for your sister!" the mother said angrily to her son.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The students usually have their lunch in the school c______a. The meals served there are healthy and delicious.
= cafeteria
~詞義 cafeteria（n.）(學生的)自助餐廳
~原文 The students usually have their lunch in the school cafeteria. The meals served there are healthy and delicious.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The teacher was disappointed to find out that the student had been ______ (honest) about finishing his project on his own.
= dishonest
~詞義 dishonest（adj.）不誠實的
~原文 The teacher was disappointed to find out that the student had been dishonest about finishing his project on his own.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Our English teacher reminded us to always check the ______ (pronounce) of unfamiliar words in the dictionary so that we say them correctly.
= pronunciation
~詞義 pronunciation（n.）發音
~原文 Our English teacher reminded us to always check the pronunciation of unfamiliar words in the dictionary so that we say them correctly.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The mountain road was so ______ that drivers could barely see a few meters ahead.
A: jealous
B: honest
C: foggy
D: skinny
= C
~詞義 foggy（adj.）有霧的
~原文 The mountain road was so foggy that drivers could barely see a few meters ahead.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Sandy buys her ______ at the local farmer's market every weekend; the food there are very fresh.
A: groceries
B: heaters
C: carpets
D: flutes
= A
~詞義 grocery（n.）生鮮雜貨
~原文 Sandy buys her groceries at the local farmer's market every weekend; the food there are very fresh.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: My favorite subject in school is ______ because I like to learn about other places around the world.
A: handkerchief
B: pharmacy
C: dragonfly
D: geography
= D
~詞義 geography（n.）地理
~原文 My favorite subject in school is geography because I like to learn about other places around the world.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Michael has a cold, but the clinic is closed. He can only buy medicine at a ______ for now.
A: hanger
B: drugstore
C: trumpet
D: grocery
= B
~詞義 drugstore（n.）藥妝店
~原文 Michael has a cold, but the clinic is closed. He can only buy medicine at a drugstore for now.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: To be ______, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. I'm surprised that you actually succeeded.
A: hateful
B: grassy
C: frank
D: dizzy
= C
~詞義 frank（adj.）坦誠的
~原文 To be frank, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. I'm surprised that you actually succeeded.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: dragged
B: donkey
C: chin
D: hammered
E: handkerchief
F: flour

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The workers ______ at the broken metal gate for hours, trying to bend it back into shape.
= D
~詞義 hammer（v.）用力敲擊
~原文 The workers hammered at the broken metal gate for hours, trying to bend it back into shape.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The bag was too heavy to carry, so the old man ______ it into the room.
= A
~詞義 drag（v.）拉;拖
~原文 The bag was too heavy to carry, so the old man dragged it into the room.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: David fell from the stairs and hit his ______ on the floor. Luckily, none of his teeth fell out.
= C
~詞義 chin（n.）下巴
~原文 David fell from the stairs and hit his chin on the floor. Luckily, none of his teeth fell out.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The farmer loaded all the hay onto the back of his ______, which then carried it back to the barn.
= B
~詞義 donkey（n.）驢子
~原文 The farmer loaded all the hay onto the back of his donkey, which then carried it back to the barn.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The old lady blew her nose loudly into the ______ and then used it to wipe her tears away.
= E
~詞義 handkerchief（n.）手帕
~原文 The old lady blew her nose loudly into the handkerchief and then used it to wipe her tears away.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: dizzy
B: doughnuts
C: clay
D: downtown
E: carpeted
F: hateful

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The artist is good at working with ______; she makes beautiful vases and cups out of it.
= C
~詞義 clay（n.）陶土
~原文 The artist is good at working with clay; she makes beautiful vases and cups out of it.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: There are many tall office buildings in the ______ area.
= D
~詞義 downtown（adj.）市中心的
~原文 There are many tall office buildings in the downtown area.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The man tried to spread ______ rumors about his colleague throughout the office, but no one listened to him.
= F
~詞義 hateful（adj.）令人厭惡的
~原文 The man tried to spread hateful rumors about his colleague throughout the office, but no one listened to him.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: We bought some ______ and milk tea as an afternoon snack.
= B
~詞義 doughnut（n.）甜甜圈
~原文 We bought some doughnuts and milk tea as an afternoon snack.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Every autumn, the park would be ______ with golden leaves, and the ground would look magical.
= E
~詞義 carpet（v.）覆蓋著一層(be carpeted with)
~原文 Every autumn, the park would be carpeted with golden leaves, and the ground would look magical.
